newsitem.title: USA: Callon files for $15 million in notes.
newsitem.headline: Callon files for $15 million in notes.

text.p: Callon Petroleum Co said Tuesday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $15 million in senior subordinated notes maturing December 15, 2001.
Interest on the notes is payable quarterly on December 15, March 15, June 15 and September 15, the filing said.
The underwriters have been granted a 30-day over-allotment option of up to an additional $2.25 million aggregate principal amount of notes. The offering will be made through Morgan Keegan & Co Inc.
The company intends to use the net proceeds to fund a portion of its remaining 1996 and its 1997 capital expenditure budget, the filing said.
Callon, of Natchez, Mississippi, and its predecessors have been engaged in the acquisition, development, exploration and production of oil and gas since 1950.
